'''November 2000 Tucson tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at HardCastle Cards, Tucson, Arizona on 12 November 2000. [[Enrique Huerta]] won it. It is known from Justin Beal's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1452">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-12-tucson-az-11-12-2000-hardcastled1452/ tucson-az-11-12-2000-hardcastle], DeckTech (Justin "Bubba Joe" Beal, 12 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-12-tucson-az-11-12-2000-hardcastled1452/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 12 November 2000
* '''Site:''' HardCastle Cards, Tucson, Arizona
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Enrique Huerta]]
